summary: A row of small outlined filter buttons that stays on one line and scrolls sideways, with no scrollbar drawn.
use: A quick-filter strip above a list where every option must stay reachable and none should be hidden in a menu.
spec: Eight small outlined neutral `Button`s generated from a list
`overflow="scroll"` keeps the row on one line and scrolls it sideways with no scrollbar drawn; the buttons keep their size
